reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core idea of P4 and P9—inverting a continuous B2 matrix to a continuous BCC matrix with discrete B2 precipitates via heat treatment—and applies it to TiVNbTa, a different alloy, but without any new mechanistic insight or justification for why this transfer should work. The mechanism and predicted outcome are taken almost verbatim from P4, P26, and P35, making this a straightforward application of a known approach to a new composition.
copied_elements: aging treatment to precipitate B2 in BCC matrix
inverted BCC+B2 microstructure with discrete B2 precipitates
improved high-temperature strength with retained ductility
